instructions.name: adl_step
docs: Auto-Deleverage step. Drains up to `target_loss_micro` USDC from the
passed-in winner CMs (in `remaining_accounts` as pairs of
(cm_pda, cm_escrow_ata)). Per-CM cap = 50% of free_collateral.
Returns total drained.

accounts.name: authority
docs: W-023 authorization mirror — Layers 4-5 socialise non-defaulting
CM equity. Restrict to SKEW_AUTHORITY until Phase 2 governance
multisig lands.

accounts.name: authority
docs: W-024: address-pinned at constraint level — defense in depth so a
future handler refactor cannot accidentally skip the authority check.

accounts.name: payoff_token_account
docs: Receives the holder payoff. Owner validated against `option.holder`.

accounts.name: creator_refund_token_account
docs: Receives the residual collateral (collateral - payoff, or full collateral
when no holder / OTM).

accounts.name: position_registry
docs: W6 zero-copy.

accounts.name: current_holder_option_ata
docs: `mint == option_token_mint` + `owner == payoff_token_account.owner` +
`amount == 1`.

instructions.name: apply_buyback_via_rfq_action
docs: Apply: trigger buyback-via-RFQ flow (writer side). Fail-closed until
direct RFQ CPI exists; does not emit-and-close.

instructions.name: apply_close_isolated_action
docs: Apply: drain IsolatedVault → user (full close). Fully wired.

accounts.name: user
docs: Order authority (= IsolatedVault user). Must sign because we're
transferring USDC out of vault back to user_ata, and the
IsolatedVault PDA's stored `user` field gates this.

accounts.name: order
docs: Triggered conditional order. Closed at end → rent + keeper-reward
surplus refunded to user.

accounts.name: option
docs: Action target option — pinned to order.action_target.

accounts.name: vault
docs: IsolatedVault for (user, option). The vault.user must == user;
the vault.option must == order.action_target.

accounts.name: user_ata
docs: User's USDC ATA — receives drained vault funds.

accounts.name: vault_escrow
docs: Vault's escrow ATA — drained from.

instructions.name: apply_early_exercise_action
docs: Apply: early-exercise. Fail-closed until a direct
`early_exercise_option` CPI exists; does not emit-and-close.

instructions.name: apply_sell_via_rfq_action
docs: Apply: trigger sell-via-RFQ flow. Fail-closed until direct CPI into
`register_rfq_auction` exists; does not emit-and-close.

instructions.name: atomic_fill_from_relay
docs: v4 RFQ Relay — atomic 1-ix fill consumed by the relay WebSocket server
(`skew-relay/`). Replaces `create_rfq`+`fill_rfq`+`cancel_rfq` with a
single, Ed25519-verified fill. Two Ed25519 verify instructions (buyer
sig + CM sig) MUST precede this instruction in the same tx.
Phase B live (structural consolidation): full Ed25519 sig
verification, SPL CPI (collateral + premium + fee), Metaplex, CM update.
See `docs/interfaces/relay-payload-v1.md` for the authoritative payload
byte layout shared with the infra `skew-relay/` server.

accounts.name: option
docs: The OptionAccount this instruction creates and funds in one shot.
Seeds pin the option PDA to the seller CM + relay_nonce so replay
attacks across CMs are impossible.
`Box<Account<…>>` lifts the 264 B account body to the heap so
`try_accounts` stays inside the 4 KB BPF stack limit.

accounts.name: seller_cm
docs: Seller Clearing Member. Must be registered and not under liquidation.

accounts.name: rfq_maker_registry
docs: RFQ maker bond + compact MMP controls. Required for Instant RFQ fills:
a CM that wants to quote must be a registered maker with a live kill
switch and rolling-window protection.

accounts.name: position_registry
docs: W6 zero-copy. Field-access constraints (`bump`, `authority`)
migrated to handler-side `require!()` because `AccountLoader`
can't read the body until `.load()`.

accounts.name: buyer
docs: Buyer — pays premium + fee, receives the option token.

accounts.name: settlement_mint
docs: W6.2 — unboxed. Anchor's typed `Account<Mint>` deserialize inflated
the `try_accounts` stack frame past 4 KB on this 28-account ix. We
drop the typed wrapper and verify mint key + decimals in the
handler from the raw byte buffer.
`payload.settlement_mint`); decimals read at offset 44 (SPL Mint
layout: COption<Pubkey> 36 + supply 8 = 44 → decimals u8).

accounts.name: collateral_policy
docs: W6.2 — unboxed for stack reasons. Handler verifies the PDA seed +
bump + walks the entries array via manual byte offsets.

accounts.name: buyer_premium_ata
docs: Buyer's settlement-mint ATA (premium source).

accounts.name: seller_premium_ata
docs: CM premium destination. Handler accepts either:
- seller authority's settlement ATA (cash-out), or
- canonical CM escrow PDA (auto-reinvest premium into margin equity).

accounts.name: fee_accumulator
docs: Skew fee accumulator PDA (receives the taker fee).
W-022: seeds-constrained so an attacker cannot route the taker fee to
an arbitrary account. Mirrors the buy_option.rs fee_accumulator pattern.
to keep this hot-path `try_accounts` under the BPF stack ceiling.

accounts.name: fee_authority
docs: Fee authority PDA — no stored data; token authority for fee_accumulator.

accounts.name: seller_collateral_ata
docs: Stable lane CM collateral source. For SOL inverse physical lanes this
account is ignored; the lock comes from NativeSolVault/LstVault below.

accounts.name: option_escrow
docs: Option escrow token account — authority = option PDA.
Holds locked collateral until settle/liquidate/expire dispatches.

accounts.name: swb_aggregator
docs: sentinel accepted under `devnet-frozen-pyth` (Pyth-only fallback).

accounts.name: governance
docs: W6.2 — unboxed. Handler walks the byte buffer for `paused` (offset
8 disc + 184 in body = 192) and PDA seed/bump verification.

accounts.name: buyer_volume_tracker
docs: Buyer (taker) 30-day rolling volume tracker. **PR #1 (Phase 1)**:
`init_if_needed` was the auto-init-on-first-fill convenience but cost
~7-9 KCU per fill. Now `mut` only — caller MUST pre-init via the
`init_volume_tracker(authority)` ix (lib.rs:596) before the first
relay fill. `cu_baseline.json::phase_targets.phase_1` reflects this.

accounts.name: seller_volume_tracker
docs: Seller CM authority 30-day rolling volume tracker. Same migration
as `buyer_volume_tracker` — pre-init required.

accounts.name: fee_config
docs: W6.2 — unboxed. Singleton fee config; handler verifies PDA seed.

accounts.name: builder_code
docs: handler to keep Anchor `try_accounts` under the BPF stack ceiling.

accounts.name: builder_escrow
docs: is passed. USDC lane uses the fee-authority-owned builder escrow PDA;
physical wSOL/jitoSOL lanes pay directly to the builder's settlement
mint token account. SPL layout/mint/owner are checked manually in the
handler to keep Anchor `try_accounts` under the BPF stack ceiling.

accounts.name: premium_from
docs: Buyer's settlement-mint token account.  Source of premium.

accounts.name: premium_to
docs: Creator's settlement-mint token account.  Destination of premium.

accounts.name: settlement_mint
docs: Settlement mint — validated against `option.settlement_mint`.

accounts.name: option_token_mint
docs: Option-token mint PDA.  `init_if_needed` (Option A, v1.2): first buyer
pays rent; subsequent calls just validate the existing mint.
Mint authority = option PDA so `mint_to` can be signed by option seeds.

accounts.name: option_token_to
docs: Buyer's option-token ATA.  Destination of the `mint_to` CPI.

accounts.name: metadata_pda
docs: Seed layout (Metaplex program): `[b"metadata", mpl_program_id, option_token_mint]`.
Anchor cannot verify cross-program seeds; validation deferred to CPI.

accounts.name: fee_accumulator
docs: Skew fee accumulator token account for this settlement mint.
`init_if_needed` — first buyer in a given mint pays rent (~0.002 SOL, one-time).
Authority = fee_authority PDA; transfers out only via `withdraw_fees`.

accounts.name: fee_authority
docs: Fee authority PDA — no stored data; only referenced as token authority for
fee_accumulator init and as CPI signer in `withdraw_fees`.

accounts.name: sigma_iv_pda
docs: Singleton IV surface PDA updated by SKEW_AUTHORITY crank.
Provides T<7d / T≥7d σ_IV for option pricing.
Validated: 0.01 < σ_IV < 5.0 (SkewError::InvalidSigmaIv 6031).

accounts.name: governance
docs: Read-only. Rejects premium payment while governance.paused = true.

accounts.name: buyer_volume_tracker
docs: Buyer (taker) 30-day rolling volume tracker — auto-init.

accounts.name: fee_config
docs: Singleton fee config — drives the maker rebate phase scale.

instructions.name: calculate_margin
docs: Boundary-Aware IM master formula (§10): max(ScanRisk, Boundary) ×
(1+L_a)(1+C_P) + TailAddOn − ICCcredit. Full Phase B live.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless — keeper, liquidation bot, or the CM itself may call.

accounts.name: cm
docs: CM whose margin is being recalculated.

instructions.name: call_variation_margin
docs: Phase 1633.B1 — daily portfolio IM re-mark crank
(PARADIGM I3 §25503). Permissionless keeper invocation; refreshes
`cm.last_im_micro` + `last_margin_check` so liquidate.rs's
freshness gate continues to admit valid auctions even when the
CM takes no new fills.

accounts.name: keeper
docs: Permissionless — anyone may push the crank for any CM. Signer
only required by Anchor for tx authorisation; the crank itself
has no privileged side-effects (idempotent overwrite of the
`last_im_micro` snapshot, which becomes the conservative floor
for the next liquidate.rs admission).

accounts.name: cm
docs: CM whose portfolio IM is being re-computed.

instructions.name: cancel_combo_intent
docs: Buyer cancels an open combo before full execution. Refunds the
residual escrow balance back to the buyer ATA.

instructions.name: cancel_combo_intent_v2
docs: Buyer cancels a v2 combo intent (pre-completion). Refunds residual
escrow; closes PDA.

instructions.name: cancel_conditional_order
docs: Authority cancels their own active conditional order. Drains rent +
keeper-reward lamports back to authority. If the order is part of an
OCO pair, the linked order is NOT auto-cancelled here — the user
must cancel each leg separately (intentional: keeps cancel ix simple
and avoids cross-account write hazard. OCO auto-cancel happens only
on `execute_conditional_order` of one leg.)

accounts.name: authority
docs: Authority that registered the order. Must match `order.authority`.

accounts.name: order
docs: The order being cancelled. `close` directs anchor to drain rent +
keeper-reward lamports back to `authority`.

accounts.name: creator
docs: Only the creator may cancel.

accounts.name: escrow_token_account
docs: Escrow token account (authority = option PDA). Optional —
`None` when the option is in `Created` state (no
deposit_collateral yet). Required + drained-and-closed when
state == `Funded`.

accounts.name: creator_token_account
docs: Creator's settlement-token account. Optional — `None` when
state == `Created` (no escrow → no refund destination needed).

instructions.name: cancel_rfq_auction
docs: Buyer cancels their auction. Pre-close: only allowed when no
quotes received. Post-close: anyone uses finalize instead.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint pinned via escrow constraint.

accounts.name: escrow_ata
docs: Escrow ATA — drained back to buyer here. Closed after drain.

accounts.name: buyer_usdc_ata
docs: Buyer's USDC ATA — receives refund.

instructions.name: clawback_step
docs: Clawback step — pro-rata socialised loss across all passed-in winner
CMs proportional to their excess equity (collateral − last_im_micro).
Per-CM cap = 50% of that excess (`ADL_CLAWBACK_CAP_MICRO`).
Returns total drained.

instructions.name: cleanup_expired_combo_v2
docs: Permissionless cleanup of an expired v2 combo intent. Refunds
residual escrow to the original buyer (NOT the caller).

instructions.name: cleanup_expired_conditional_order
docs: Permissionless cleanup of an expired conditional order. Anyone
can call after `valid_until_ts` elapsed; rent + keeper-reward
surplus refunded to the order's authority (NOT the caller — this
prevents the cleanup ix from being abused as a free-money sink).

accounts.name: authority
docs: returned here. The caller (signer) gets nothing — the keeper
reward stash also flows back to authority on cleanup.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone can sign and pay tx fees.

accounts.name: order
docs: The expired order. `close = authority` directs anchor to drain
all lamports (rent + surplus) back to authority on close.

instructions.name: cleanup_expired_emergency
docs: Permissionless cleanup callable after 24h of inactivity. Clears
`emergency.active = false` only — `governance.paused` remains
until council acts via `governance_execute(UnpauseProtocol)` or
`governance_propose(PauseProtocol)`. Prevents an emergency-pause
from permanently halting the protocol when council fails to act.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless caller (anyone — keeper/dapp/end-user).

instructions.name: close_builder_code
docs: Builder closes their PDA and reclaims the deposit (only if 30-day
routed volume below floor).

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless — any caller can poke cleanup after the grace period.

accounts.name: creator
docs: Receives lamports from the closed option PDA and escrow token account.

accounts.name: escrow_token_account
docs: Escrow token account owned by the option PDA.

accounts.name: creator_token_account
docs: Creator's settlement-token ATA. Receives any residual escrow balance.
W-016: authority pinned to `creator` — permissionless callers cannot
redirect the refund to an attacker-controlled account.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless cleanup. The lock rent always returns to the writer.

instructions.name: close_sigma_iv
docs: Devnet migration: close a stale sigma_iv_pda so update_sigma_iv can re-init it.

accounts.name: sigma_iv_pda
docs: be deserialized as the v4 SigmaIvPda struct. We verify the PDA seeds
manually in the handler and close via lamport drain.

instructions.name: cm_add_collateral
docs: Add collateral to an existing CM (Phase B SPL CPI wiring).

instructions.name: cm_withdraw_collateral
docs: Withdraw collateral — guarded by free_collateral + under_liquidation.

instructions.name: create_option
docs: `create_option(nonce, option_type, asset, direction, strike, expiry_ts,
payoff_amount, settlement_decimals, upper_bound, extra_param,
spot_at_creation, sigma_at_creation)`.
v2.1 signature adds (spot_at_creation, sigma_at_creation) on top of v2.
Handler computes V_0 on-chain via `pricing::v0_from_integer_px` and
stamps it on `OptionAccount.v0_usdc_micro` for the Boundary-Aware IM
floor `max(IM_scenario, M − V_0)`.

accounts.name: underlying_feed
docs: freshness and owner. Stored as pubkey reference only.

accounts.name: metadata_pda
docs: (anchor-plus Day 5 wires `CreateMetadataAccountV3` inside `buy_option.rs`).

accounts.name: governance
docs: Read-only. Rejects new option creation while governance.paused = true.

accounts.name: rfq_escrow
docs: Escrow holding buyer's premium until fill or cancel.
Authority = rfq PDA; transfers out via `fill_rfq` or `cancel_rfq`.

instructions.name: default_waterfall_drain
docs: Drain the 6-tier default waterfall (called by anchor-plus liquidate.rs).

accounts.name: insurance_fund
docs: Singleton Insurance Fund.

accounts.name: defaulting_cm
docs: Defaulting CM. Phase B `liquidate.rs` flags `under_liquidation = true`
before calling into here, and sets it back to `false` (or closes the
account) after the cascade resolves.

accounts.name: authority
docs: W-023: address-pinned to SKEW_AUTHORITY so this standalone instruction
cannot be called by arbitrary accounts to corrupt CM / IF accounting.
(liquidate.rs uses drain_cascade() directly and never CPIs here.)

instructions.name: delist_series
docs: Permissionless close. Two gates: now ≥ expiry_ts, total_oi_count
== 0. Caller receives rent refund.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Caller receives the rent refund (Anchor `close = caller`).

instructions.name: deposit_isolated
docs: User → vault escrow USDC transfer.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Vault — verified by seed binding (user, option).

instructions.name: deposit_lst_collateral
docs: User → vault escrow LST transfer. Validates the SPL Stake Pool
account address + layout in passing so the vault stamps a fresh
`last_er_update_slot` for the dynamic LTV cap path downstream.

accounts.name: user_lst_ata
docs: User's source LST ATA. Authority must be the user.

accounts.name: vault_ata
docs: Vault escrow ATA (authority = vault PDA).

accounts.name: stake_pool
docs: SPL Stake Pool account for the LST. Used to stamp a fresh ER
slot on the vault. Address-pinned to the canonical jitoSOL pool.
inside `lst::read_stake_pool_er`.

instructions.name: deposit_native_sol_collateral
docs: User wSOL ATA → vault escrow transfer. The user is responsible for
wrapping native SOL → wSOL on the client side prior to deposit
(`system_program::transfer` + `sync_native`).

accounts.name: wsol_mint
docs: wSOL mint constraint — same canonical pubkey as init.

accounts.name: user_wsol_ata
docs: User's source wSOL ATA. The user must have wrapped native SOL
to wSOL on the client side (`system_program::transfer` + `sync_native`)
before calling deposit. Authority = user.

accounts.name: vault_ata
docs: Vault escrow ATA (authority = vault PDA).

instructions.name: deposit_to_if
docs: Deposit to a specific IF tier / SITG slot.

accounts.name: contributing_cm
docs: Required when `tier == IfTier::Tier2 && !is_sitg`; records the
defaulting-member contribution so `default_waterfall` Tier-2 is live.

instructions.name: downgrade_tier
docs: Downgrade the CM's verified tier (releases lockup back into
`free_collateral`). Requires `now ≥ cm.tier_locked_until` and a
strict rank decrease.

instructions.name: emergency_pause
docs: Single-key emergency pause. Bypasses the 24h timelock that
`governance_propose(PauseProtocol) → governance_execute` requires.
Sets `governance.paused = true` directly. SKEW_AUTHORITY only.

accounts.name: authority
docs: SKEW_AUTHORITY only.

accounts.name: emergency
docs: Singleton emergency state.

accounts.name: governance
docs: Canonical governance multisig — `paused` flipped to true here.
Same singleton `governance.paused` field that all trade ix gate on.

instructions.name: emergency_resume
docs: SKEW_AUTHORITY single-key revert (false-alarm path). Sets both
`emergency.active = false` and `governance.paused = false`.

accounts.name: authority
docs: SKEW_AUTHORITY only.

accounts.name: governance
docs: Canonical governance — `paused` flipped to false here.

instructions.name: execute_conditional_order
docs: Permissionless keeper trigger. Reads the order's oracle, checks
trigger condition, applies grace logic, marks Triggered + emits
the event when the action should fire. The actual close /
sell-via-RFQ / buyback is performed by a follow-up ix the keeper
submits after observing `ConditionalOrderTriggered` (Drift v2-style
2-step pattern). Auto-cancels the linked OCO partner if any. Pays
keeper reward in lamports skimmed from the order PDA's surplus.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone can trigger (permissionless). Receives the keeper-reward
lamports skimmed from the order PDA.

accounts.name: order
docs: The order being evaluated.

accounts.name: trigger_oracle
docs: to `order.trigger_oracle` so caller can't pass an alternate feed.

accounts.name: action_target
docs: P2-H (2026-05-01): action target option, pinned to
`order.action_target`. Anchor deserialises so `option.state ==
Active` can be enforced before any state mutation. Read-only —
the actual close/sell/buyback action is performed by a follow-up
`apply_*_action` ix (Drift v2 trigger pattern, separate tx).

accounts.name: linked_order
docs: Optional linked OCO order. Pass when `order.is_oco_paired()` to
auto-cancel the partner; otherwise pass the same `order` pubkey
(Anchor will fail constraint cleanly).

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless — any signer may call after the grace period.

accounts.name: escrow_token_account
docs: Escrow token account holding locked collateral (authority = option PDA).

accounts.name: creator_refund_token_account
docs: Creator's settlement-token account.  Receives the returned collateral.
W-017: authority pinned at constraint level — consistent with W-014 pattern.

accounts.name: option
docs: Pre-funded option by underwriter.  Seeds validated; spec validated in handler.

instructions.name: finalize_combo_intent
docs: Finalise once all legs filled — flips status to `Active` and refunds
any unspent premium residual.

accounts.name: combo
docs: 10-pass audit F1 — close the combo PDA so the rent (~0.002 SOL)
returns to the buyer once the strategy is fully active. The combo
has fulfilled its commitment role (all legs filled); the legs
themselves persist as standalone OptionAccounts that the buyer
holds via the option-token NFT and settles via the normal flow.

instructions.name: finalize_combo_leg_v2
docs: Mark a single leg of a v2 combo as filled. Permissionless (keeper).
Auto-flips intent.status to Active when the last leg fills.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless — keeper or buyer can call.

instructions.name: finalize_rfq_auction
docs: Permissionless price-discovery finalization after auction close_slot.
RFQ auction v1 refunds the escrow and emits the winning quote for the
keeper / Instant RFQ lane to hand off into `atomic_fill_from_relay`.
It does not mint the option or transfer premium itself.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless. Tx fees on the caller; settlement effects are on
the auction PDA + escrow drain to buyer.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint pinned via escrow constraint.

accounts.name: escrow_ata
docs: Auction's escrow ATA — drained back to buyer here in this Phase 1
keeper-mediated path. The single-tx atomic settlement (premium →
MM, refund → buyer, option mint, collateral lock all in one ix)
is implemented as **`fill_from_settled_auction`** (Phase 57301-B,
2026-05-04, currently on wip branch — pending W1 종합 deploy).
`atomic_fill_from_relay` cannot be used here because its dual
ed25519 sig requirement (RelayPayload digest ≠ rfq_quote_digest)
makes the keeper unable to forge signatures for the departed
buyer + MM. Spec drift: D2.2 in
`docs/refactor/AUDIT_W1_2_SPEC_DRIFT_2026-05-04.md`.

accounts.name: buyer_usdc_ata
docs: Buyer's USDC ATA — receives refund. Address-pinned to auction.buyer
via token::authority constraint.

instructions.name: governance_approve
docs: W4.6 (2026-05-05) — multisig member 가 추가 approval 박는 ix.
proposer 외 4 명이 이 ix 호출해서 threshold (= governance.threshold)
도달 후 governance_execute 가 통과 가능. 3차 finding 3-P1a fix —
기존 path 는 1/5 (proposer 만) 으로 멈춰서 emergency path 만 작동.

accounts.name: proposal
docs: ProposalPda — caller-provided. seeds verified through Anchor.

accounts.name: member
docs: Council member adding their approval. Must be one of
`governance.members[0..5]`.

instructions.name: governance_execute
docs: Execute an approved, timelock-elapsed governance proposal. Spec §15.

accounts.name: governance
docs: Singleton governance multisig PDA. `mut` because the
PauseProtocol / UnpauseProtocol dispatch (Phase 1517a.H) toggles
`governance.paused`. Other variants (UpdateParam / ListAsset / ...)
land in subsequent atomics and may need additional `remaining_accounts`.

accounts.name: proposal
docs: Per-proposal PDA. `mut` to stamp executed_at_slot + executed flag.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Caller (any signer — execution is permissionless once timelock +
threshold conditions are met). The keeper bot (infra cron) is
the typical caller.

instructions.name: governance_propose
docs: Queue a governance proposal — 3/5 multisig + 24 h timelock. Spec §15.

accounts.name: governance
docs: Singleton governance multisig PDA. Mutated to bump
`next_proposal_id`.

accounts.name: proposal
docs: Per-proposal PDA — id = `governance.next_proposal_id` BEFORE
increment. Seeds locked at the snapshotted id so the PDA is
reproducible off-chain.
SAFETY: the seed `next_id_le` is computed from
`governance.next_proposal_id.to_le_bytes()` AT INVOCATION; the
handler bumps the counter only after the proposal init succeeds
so a failed init does not skip an id slot.

accounts.name: proposer
docs: Council member submitting the proposal. MUST be one of
`governance.members[*]` — checked in `handler`.

instructions.name: governance_set_maker_rebate_phase
docs: Governance-toggled maker rebate phase scale. `phase_bps` ∈ [0, 10_000].

instructions.name: governance_set_series_max_oi
docs: M6 (2026-05-03) — SKEW_AUTHORITY sets per-series `max_oi_count` cap.
`cap = 0` removes the cap (default for newly listed series). Existing
OI is never force-closed; the cap only blocks NEW fills.

accounts.name: authority
docs: SKEW_AUTHORITY only. Phase 2 transitions to Squads 2-of-3 multisig
via the same address gate (multisig signer == SKEW_AUTHORITY).

accounts.name: series
docs: SeriesListingPda whose `max_oi_count` is being mutated. The PDA
seed match (anchor `seeds = [..]`) ensures the caller cannot
rewrite an arbitrary account's cap field.

instructions.name: init_collateral_policy
docs: W4.5 (2026-05-05) — CollateralPolicyPda init (SKEW_AUTHORITY-gated).
2차 F4 + 1차 L2 잠금 prerequisite. mainnet pre-launch 단계 governance
multisig 로 마이그레이션 (W4.5.gov deferred).

instructions.name: init_emergency_pause
docs: One-time singleton init for `EmergencyPausePda`. SKEW_AUTHORITY only.

accounts.name: authority
docs: SKEW_AUTHORITY only.

accounts.name: emergency
docs: Singleton PDA — init.

instructions.name: init_fee_accumulator
docs: Permissionless per-mint bootstrap for the deterministic fee accumulator.
Required before hot `atomic_fill_from_relay` flows for wSOL/jitoSOL.

instructions.name: init_fee_config
docs: One-shot SKEW_AUTHORITY init for the singleton FeeConfigPda.

instructions.name: init_governance
docs: Initialise the singleton GovernanceMultisig PDA (SKEW_AUTHORITY only, one-shot).

accounts.name: authority
docs: W-028 pattern: pin to upgrade authority so no race is possible.

instructions.name: init_insurance_fund
docs: Initialise the singleton Insurance Fund (SKEW_AUTHORITY only).

accounts.name: authority
docs: W-028: address-pinned at constraint level so no other signer can race to
initialize the singleton IF PDA before the protocol team.

instructions.name: init_isolated_vault
docs: One-shot per (user, option) — initialise the IsolatedVault PDA + escrow ATA.

accounts.name: user
docs: User authority — pays rent, becomes the vault owner.

accounts.name: option
docs: The bound option PDA. Caller must already hold (or be in the
process of writing) this option; the vault doesn't enforce
holder/creator equality (a sophisticated user may pre-fund both
sides). `option.state` stays untouched here — vault just
records the binding.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint — must match the option's settlement mint.

instructions.name: init_lst_vault
docs: One-shot per (user, lst_mint) — initialise the LstVault PDA
+ escrow ATA. Subsequent deposits + withdraws hang off this PDA.

accounts.name: lst_mint
docs: LST mint. Phase 1 ships only jitoSOL; future LSTs (mSOL etc.)
add an extra mint constraint arm here when wired.

accounts.name: vault_ata
docs: Vault SPL token account (escrow holding the deposited LST).
Authority = vault PDA.

instructions.name: init_native_sol_vault
docs: One-shot per user — initialise the NativeSolVault PDA + wSOL escrow
ATA. No mint dimension (single wSOL mint per protocol).

accounts.name: wsol_mint
docs: wSOL mint — production canonical native_mint (`So11111...`).
Pinned by constraint so a malicious caller cannot pass a fake
mint to subvert the deposit/withdraw flow.

accounts.name: vault_ata
docs: Vault SPL token account (escrow holding the deposited wSOL).
Authority = vault PDA.

instructions.name: init_position_registry
docs: Init the per-CM PositionRegistry PDA. W6.1 split-out from
`register_clearing_member` so each ix init at most one large account
(registry body = 1104 B). CM authority signs + pays rent.

accounts.name: cm
docs: CM PDA — must already exist.

instructions.name: init_volume_tracker
docs: Permissionless one-shot per-authority init of the VolumeTrackerPda.

instructions.name: liquidate
docs: Dutch-auction partial liquidation (Phase B Task #8).
Off-chain `skew-liq-bot` calls this when a CM's equity ratio < 1.10.
Bonus linear ramps 2% → 10% over 60s; partial close cap 50%; Bug #17
insolvency guard cascades through `default_waterfall_drain` when the
payout exceeds CM posted collateral.
Phase B live (structural consolidation): Dutch auction partial
close with adaptive Lyapunov fraction (§12.5) + post-check equity guard.
W3.3.b (2026-05-05) — `min_expected_bonus_bps` arg added (slippage
floor). Liquidator passes the bonus bps observed at view-time;
handler rejects when the actual effective bonus drops below this
floor (front-run defense — another liquidator partial-closed first
in the same Dutch ramp slot, eroding the remaining payout). pass
`0` to skip the check (backwards-compatible default for
SDKs not yet migrated).

accounts.name: option
docs: Target option. Must be in `Active` state and belong to `defaulting_cm`.

accounts.name: defaulting_cm
docs: Defaulting Clearing Member — MUST be the option creator's registered CM.
W-021: seeds derived from `option.creator`, not `defaulting_cm.authority`,
so an attacker cannot substitute a victim CM to redirect the
`drain_cascade` shortfall CPI and drain unrelated collateral.

accounts.name: position_registry
docs: W6 zero-copy. Field-access constraints moved to handler `require!()`.

accounts.name: insurance_fund
docs: Singleton Insurance Fund — Tier-3/4 drain path.

accounts.name: option_escrow
docs: Option escrow token account. Authority = option PDA.
Holds the collateral locked at fill; this instruction drains a portion
scaled by `close_factor_bps * (1 + bonus)` to the liquidator.

accounts.name: cm_escrow
docs: CM escrow token account. Authority = defaulting_cm PDA.
Tier-0 + Tier-1 waterfall drains flow from here. Tier-2 IF contribution
drains from `if_escrow`.

accounts.name: if_escrow
docs: IF escrow token account. Authority = insurance_fund PDA.
Tier-3 (Protocol SITG) + Tier-4 (mutualized) drains flow from here.

accounts.name: liquidator_payout_ata
docs: Liquidator's payout destination (must be the settlement mint).

accounts.name: settlement_mint
docs: Settlement mint pinned to the option's `settlement_mint`.

accounts.name: liquidator
docs: Liquidator — funds the init rent + receives the discounted payout.

instructions.name: list_series
docs: One-shot per (asset, strike, expiry_ts, option_type, direction).
Caller pays rent (~0.0009 SOL). Off-chain keeper invokes daily
for σ·√T grid cells. No σ·√T validation on-chain — the keeper's
grid policy lives off-chain so future tuning (k_max / n_strikes)
doesn't require a redeploy.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Caller pays rent. Permissionless — no SKEW_AUTHORITY constraint.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless — any signer may call once the normal window has closed.

instructions.name: rebalance_pm_lock
docs: Recompute PM and release excess per-option marginal IM back into the
writer CM escrow. `max_release_amount = 0` means release all safe excess.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless. Excess is returned only to the writer's CM escrow PDA.

instructions.name: register_builder
docs: Builder posts $1K USDC anti-spam deposit + 32-byte label.

accounts.name: builder_token_account
docs: Source of the $1K USDC anti-spam deposit. Authority = builder.

accounts.name: builder_escrow
docs: Dedicated escrow for this builder's refundable deposit and accrued
builder fee share. This keeps builder obligations separate from the
protocol fee accumulator.

instructions.name: register_clearing_member
docs: CM onboarding — Phase 1 permissionless.

accounts.name: cm
docs: CM PDA — one per authority.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: Settlement mint for CM collateral. W4 pins accepted mints through
CollateralPolicy; fake SPL mints and decimal mismatches are rejected
before custody is initialized.

accounts.name: authority_usdc_ata
docs: Authority's USDC source ATA. Must be owned by `authority` and mint-match.

accounts.name: cm_escrow
docs: Per-CM escrow SPL token account. Authority = CM PDA so only
`cm_withdraw_collateral` (signed by this PDA) can move funds out.

instructions.name: register_collateral_policy_entry
docs: W4.5 — register a settlement/collateral mint into the policy
allowlist. atomic_fill / buy_option / fill_rfq 의 mint check 와
detect_lst_depeg_bps 의 oracle wire 가 W4.5.b/c (deferred) 에서
이 PDA 를 read.

instructions.name: register_combo_intent
docs: Register a multi-leg combo intent — escrow total max premium + pin
the leg specs (option PDA, side ±1, per-leg max premium).

instructions.name: register_combo_intent_v2
docs: Register a 1..=32-leg combo intent. Atomic at registration; per-leg
fills happen via `atomic_fill_relay` followed by
`finalize_combo_leg_v2` which records the realised premium.

instructions.name: register_conditional_order
docs: Register a single (non-OCO) conditional order. Buyer-side actions
(Sell, EarlyExercise) require holder == authority; writer-side
actions (Buyback, CloseIsolatedPosition) require creator ==
authority. Funds the keeper-reward escrow at register time.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Order authority. Funds the rent + the keeper-reward escrow.

accounts.name: order
docs: Per-(authority, order_id) PDA. order_id is supplied by the user
and must not collide with an existing one — Anchor's `init`
constraint enforces this.

accounts.name: action_target
docs: `OptionAccount` PDA the action operates on. Read-only during
registration — only existence + ownership checked here.

instructions.name: register_oco_pair
docs: Register an OCO (One-Cancels-Other) pair atomically. Two
`ConditionalOrderPda` accounts are init'd in one tx with
cross-`linked_order` references; both must target the same
option position. Typical use: stop-loss + take-profit on the
same position. When one fires via `execute_conditional_order`,
the partner is auto-cancelled by that same instruction (state
flipped to Cancelled, rent reclaimable via cancel ix).

accounts.name: order_a
docs: First leg (typically stop-loss).

accounts.name: order_b
docs: Second leg (typically take-profit). Must have a different order_id
(anchor's `init` will reject same-seed collision either way).

accounts.name: action_target
docs: Action target — both orders must operate on the same option PDA
(typical OCO use-case).

instructions.name: register_option_metadata
docs: Phase 4 AF-2 (2026-05-02) — Metaplex metadata lazy registration.
Permissionless, idempotent. Canonical caller: `skew-relay` after
`atomic_fill_from_relay` confirm. See `register_option_metadata.rs`
for the full rationale + trust model.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless caller. Pays rent for the Metaplex metadata account.
Canonical caller: `skew-relay` (auto-invoked after `atomic_fill_from_relay`
confirm). Fallback: keeper / holder / dapp — anyone with SOL.

accounts.name: option
docs: Option PDA. Seeds verify it is a real Skew option.
Idempotency: handler returns silently if `option.metadata` is already
non-default (i.e. metadata previously registered).

accounts.name: option_token_mint
docs: Option token mint (created in `atomic_fill_from_relay`). The seed
constraint binds the mint to this option PDA, and `mint::authority`
confirms the option PDA owns the mint — that is the credential
Metaplex uses to sign the `CreateMetadataAccountV3` CPI.

accounts.name: metadata_pda
docs: Metaplex program — it computes `[b"metadata", mpl_program_id,
option_token_mint]` and rejects the CPI if `metadata_pda.key()`
does not match. Caller must derive this off-chain via the Metaplex
SDK and pass it as `mut` here.

accounts.name: mpl_token_metadata_program
docs: program. `lib.rs::MPL_TOKEN_METADATA_PROGRAM_ID` is the source of
truth.

instructions.name: register_rfq_auction
docs: Buyer commits to an RFQ auction with an option spec, max premium,
and a 5..=30 slot duration. Premium escrow is locked into the
per-auction PDA ATA at register time via `token::transfer` in
`register_rfq_auction_handler` (Phase 1633.G P2-D, 2026-05-01).
W1.2.b STALE-comment fix (2026-05-04): the previous "collected
at settle time (Phase 1) — Phase 2 will lock at register time"
comment was outdated by Phase 1633.G but never updated.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint — pinned via the buyer's ATA token::mint constraint.

accounts.name: buyer_usdc_ata
docs: Buyer's USDC ATA — funds the escrow at register time.

accounts.name: escrow_ata
docs: P2-D escrow ATA — created at register, drained at finalize/cancel.
Authority is the auction PDA itself.

accounts.name: governance
docs: Read-only. Rejects new RFQ registrations while paused.

instructions.name: register_rfq_maker
docs: MM stakes the slashable anti-spam deposit (1 SOL) and gets
registered. Must be called once per MM before quoting.

instructions.name: replenish_if_from_fees
docs: Auto-replenish IF Tier-3 (Protocol SITG) from the fee accumulator.
Off-chain keeper polls IF capacity vs `compute_if_target_micro`
and invokes when capacity falls below 80 % of target.
PARADIGM-LOG-PHASE-77101-87100 §A "auto-replenish".

accounts.name: fee_accumulator
docs: Source fee accumulator (one per settlement mint). Authority = fee_authority PDA.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Phase 1B (2026-05-06 final policy) — keeper-only.
SKEW_AUTHORITY signs the replenish crank after the off-chain IF target
check passes. The handler still enforces the 10% per-call cap as a
second on-chain guard.

accounts.name: old_option
docs: Expired OTM option being rolled. Closed by `close = creator` after handler.

accounts.name: new_option
docs: New option PDA initialised by this instruction.

accounts.name: old_escrow
docs: Escrow of the old option (drained by this instruction).

accounts.name: new_escrow
docs: New escrow token account for the rolled option (init by this instruction).

accounts.name: collateral_mint
docs: W-025: pin to `old_option.settlement_mint` so a caller cannot pass a
different mint and misroute the collateral transfer.

accounts.name: pyth_price
docs: Address must match old_option.underlying_feed_id — validated in handler.

instructions.name: set_maker_risk_config
docs: Configure RFQ maker quote-off / identity / margin-mode controls.
This writes compact controls into the RFQ maker registry so Instant RFQ
can enforce MMP in one extra account instead of walking quote state.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone may poke settle once expired. Must be `mut` so the v5
`init_if_needed` rent for `fee_accumulator` (first settlement of a
given settlement-mint × program-version) can be paid out of the
caller's lamports.

accounts.name: pyth_price
docs: `option.underlying_feed_id` via the `address` constraint.

accounts.name: escrow_token_account
docs: Escrow token account that holds the locked collateral.
Authority = option PDA (validated by `token::authority = option`).

accounts.name: option_token_mint
docs: (when option_token_mint doesn't exist yet — no buyer — these checks are skipped).
Expected seeds: [b"option_token_mint", option.key()].

accounts.name: current_holder_option_ata
docs: Validated as TokenAccount in handler only when has_holder == true.
Must have mint == option_token_mint and amount == 1.

accounts.name: payoff_token_account
docs: Destination for the holder's payoff (Digital/Vanilla ITM, RangeAccrual in-range).
For OTM or no-holder cases holder_amount == 0 and this account is unused;
still must be a valid settlement-mint token account.

accounts.name: creator_refund_token_account
docs: Creator's refund destination for residual collateral.
Vanilla: receives collateral - payoff. Digital OTM: receives full collateral.
RangeAccrual out-of-range: receives full collateral.
Validated in handler against option.creator.

accounts.name: position_registry
docs: W6 zero-copy. Optional because non-PM (legacy) options don't have
a tracked registry; settle path skips when missing.

accounts.name: swb_aggregator
docs: this as `UncheckedAccount` so the sentinel pubkey path works without a
discriminator failure in Anchor.

accounts.name: fee_authority
docs: Fee authority PDA — no stored data; only referenced as token authority
for `fee_accumulator` initialization. CPI signer lives in `withdraw_fees`.

instructions.name: slash_rfq_maker
docs: Single-key SKEW_AUTHORITY anti-spam slash trigger. Sets
`registry.slashable = true` + increments fail_count + emits
RfqMakerSlashed. MM 가 새 wallet 으로 register_rfq_maker 다시
해야 quote 가능. bond 1 SOL forfeit (registry PDA 에 lock).

accounts.name: slasher
docs: SKEW_AUTHORITY only.

accounts.name: registry
docs: Target MM registry — slashable flag flipped to true.
PDA seed `[RFQ_MAKER_REGISTRY_SEED, mm_pubkey]` so multiple
MMs can be slashed independently. `registry.mm` is the MM
pubkey baked into the seed (validated by `bump = registry.bump`).

instructions.name: submit_rfq_quote
docs: MM submits a "better than best" signed quote. Quote is verified
to be (a) under buyer's reserve, (b) strictly less than current
best, (c) valid past auction close. The maker_signature is stored
inline and verified at finalize via the Instructions sysvar
(Phase 2 hardening).

accounts.name: registry
docs: MM's anti-spam registry. Pinned to ensure the MM has staked the
required deposit before being allowed to quote.

accounts.name: ix_sysvar
docs: verify the preceding ed25519 verify ix carries the MM's signature
over the canonical quote-payload digest. Full ed25519 verify
implemented in `submit_rfq_quote_handler` line ~298 via
`verify_ed25519_quote(ix_sysvar, mm, auction, premium, valid_until)`
— Phase 1633.G P2-C (2026-05-01). W1.2.b STALE-comment fix
(2026-05-04): the previous "Phase 1 stub: address pinning only"
comment was outdated by Phase 1633.G but never updated.

instructions.name: submit_rfq_quote_tx_signed
docs: Browser/direct MM quote lane. The MM wallet signs the transaction
itself; no detached `signMessage` / Ed25519 sibling ix is required.
Delegated bots and HSMs should keep using `submit_rfq_quote`.

instructions.name: track_held_position
docs: Track an option token held by this CM as a PM long. Used by market
makers that buy options on Skew to hedge their writer book.

accounts.name: holder
docs: CM authority that currently holds the option token.

instructions.name: transfer_option
docs: Secondary-market holder transfer. Moves 1 SPL token + updates
`option.holder` + emits `OptionTransferred`. Permitted only when
`option.state == Active` and `now < expiry`.

accounts.name: current_holder
docs: Current holder — signer + source of the SPL option token.

accounts.name: current_holder_option_ata
docs: Current holder's option-token ATA (holds the single token).

accounts.name: new_holder
docs: the ATA below is derived from it.

accounts.name: new_holder_option_ata
docs: New holder's option-token ATA (init-if-needed pays rent from
`current_holder`).

accounts.name: option_token_mint
docs: Option-token mint PDA.

instructions.name: untrack_held_position
docs: Remove a CM-held long from the PM registry before transfer / close.

accounts.name: holder
docs: CM authority that currently holds the option token.

instructions.name: update_cross_asset_matrix
docs: Cross-asset ρ matrix writer (spec §23.9). 10 P5 ρ pairs (×1e6) +
10 stress ρ pairs ordered by `LAUNCH_PAIR_INDICES`. `update_p5` /
`update_stress` flags select subset; both may fire in one call.
Daily cadence — emits `CrossAssetMatrixUpdated`.

instructions.name: update_dvol
docs: SKEW_AUTHORITY-cranked DVOL writer. Pushes the off-chain
variance-replication integral output (28d + 90d fair-strike vol +
realised-variance accumulator) into the per-asset `DvolPda`.
Cadence: 1 h. Spec: PARADIGM-LOG-PHASE-57101-67100 §DVOL.

instructions.name: update_hamilton_state
docs: Hamilton 2-state filter writer (spec §25.4). Pushes the live
posterior `(π_calm, π_stress)` + transition matrix + debounce
counters per asset. Emits `HamiltonStateUpdated`.

instructions.name: update_microstructure
docs: Multi-venue microstructure attest writer (spec §29.9). 60-slot
cadence; SKEW_AUTHORITY signs after polling Binance / Bybit / OKX.
Emits `MicrostructureUpdated`.

instructions.name: update_povs_state
docs: PoVS streaming state writer (spec §3.2 9-step output). 12 µ-scaled
values per asset — pushed by the off-chain pipeline running EWMA σ_t /
YZ σ_∞ / Heston θ_d / AR(1) VRP / POT-GPD ξ-β / VaR_99 / ES_999 /
Hamilton r_t. Emits `PoVSStateUpdated`.

instructions.name: update_sigma_iv
docs: Authority-gated IV surface crank for the V3 5-asset launch panel.
Per asset (BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP/HYPE) the call accepts long + short σ_IV
(10 floats) gated by `update_short` / `update_long`. Source of truth
for the asset count / order: `state/asset.rs` §1 (AGENT-PROTOCOL
Article 7 — 5-asset Iron Law, founder mandate 2026-04-26).
Phase 1618 (2026-04-28) — V4 6-asset RV args
(`jup_rv`/`bonk_rv`/`wif_rv`/`sol_rv` + `update_rv`) removed; the
matching write block in `update_sigma_iv::handler` is purged. The
`SigmaIvPda` struct retains the corresponding fields (Option A,
founder Day 9 EOD §5 #4) to preserve binary compatibility with the
v1.7 layout — they are now read-only legacy slots until the next
breaking IDL bump.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Only SKEW_AUTHORITY may update the IV surface.

instructions.name: update_skew_metrics
docs: SKEW_AUTHORITY-only crank for per-asset SSVI advisor metrics
(PoVS spec §31.5 P07 + §31.6 P08): RR25 / BF25 / RR10 / ATM slope +
7-tenor IV. 1h cadence; NOT timelocked (Phase 2 multisig in
`governance_security`). 8 IV args correspond to spec §7.7 standard
tenors `{7, 14, 21, 28, 60, 90, 180, 365}` days — passed as discrete
u64 args (not an array) because Anchor's `#[program]` macro doesn't
re-export array-typed instruction args cleanly into the IDL.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Only SKEW_AUTHORITY may push updates (Phase 1 single key; Phase 2
3-of-5 council multisig).

accounts.name: skew_metrics
docs: Per-asset PDA. Initialised on first push.

instructions.name: upgrade_tier
docs: Upgrade the CM's verified tier. `target_rank` is the
`VerifiedTier` discriminant (0..=3). Requires
`cm.collateral − cm.if_contribution ≥ TIER_LOCKUP_USDC_MICRO[target]`
and a strict rank increase. Stamps `tier_locked_until = now + 30d`.

accounts.name: lst_vault
docs: CM's jitoSOL `LstVault`. When `Some`, the handler computes the
LST USD value and adds it to the eligibility pool. The locked
LST quantity is stamped into `lst_vault.tier_locked_qty`.

accounts.name: stake_pool
docs: `JITOSOL_STAKE_POOL` so a malicious caller cannot swap a fake
stake-pool that reports an inflated ER.

accounts.name: sol_usd_pyth
docs: `PYTH_SOL_USD_FEED` so a malicious caller cannot swap in a
feed that posts an inflated SOL price.

instructions.name: withdraw_builder_fees
docs: Builder pulls accrued share into their own ATA.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Must be the hardcoded Skew upgrade authority.
10-pass audit F7 — explicit error code for consistency with all
other admin gates (default_recovery, insurance_fund, dvol_ix etc.).

accounts.name: fee_accumulator
docs: Fee accumulator PDA — holds Skew's share of premiums.

accounts.name: fee_authority
docs: Fee authority PDA — signs the transfer out of the fee accumulator.

accounts.name: recipient
docs: Recipient token account — typically authority's own ATA.

instructions.name: withdraw_isolated
docs: Vault escrow → user USDC transfer. Gated on `free_micro()` so the
user can't pull USDC that's locked behind an open option fill.

instructions.name: withdraw_lst_collateral
docs: Vault escrow → user LST transfer. Gated on `free_qty()` so a
user can't pull LST that's pledged against open option fills.

instructions.name: withdraw_native_sol_collateral
docs: Vault escrow → user wSOL ATA transfer. Gated on `free_qty()` so a
user can't pull wSOL that's pledged against open option fills.

stolen authority key can't drain the CM in one tx.

docs: Unix ts of the start of the current 24-hour rolling window.

fields.name: total_pm_locked_micro
docs: Sum of `option.collateral_locked` across this CM's currently-open
writer positions. Each fill pushes its `marginal_im` (= post-trade
portfolio IM − pre-trade portfolio IM) into the option's escrow
PDA and adds the same number here; settle / close / expire paths
decrement the field by `option.collateral_locked` when the
position resolves. `free_collateral()` subtracts this so the same
USDC is never double-counted between "available to write" and
"already locked behind an open option's PM share".
Capital efficiency model — Phase 2 of the Verified-tier ladder.
Verified-tier CMs (Silver/Gold/Platinum) whose existing book
hedges a new fill see `marginal_im ≈ 0` and the new option
escrows almost no USDC; the CM keeps the saved capital free to
write more positions. Standard-tier CMs see marginal_im ≈
payoff_amount and the legacy full-notional escrow behaviour
applies (no PM benefit, conservative).

types.name: EmergencyPausePda
docs: Emergency pause state — provides a 24h-timelock-bypass path for
`governance.paused = true` so SKEW_AUTHORITY can halt the protocol
instantly when an oracle compromise / Pyth Byzantine attack is
detected. Without this, the canonical `governance_propose →
governance_execute(PauseProtocol)` path waits 24h — long enough for
an attacker to drain the protocol (W1.7 audit finding).
**Lifecycle:**
1. `init_emergency_pause` (one-time, SKEW_AUTHORITY) — singleton init.
2. `emergency_pause` (SKEW_AUTHORITY only) — sets `active = true`
+ records `started_at_slot`. Same handler also flips
`governance.paused = true` directly so all `governance.paused`
gate sites (atomic_fill, buy_option, create_option, rollover,
rfq.rs legacy, builder_code) automatically reject new fills.
3. `emergency_resume` (SKEW_AUTHORITY only) — false-alarm path.
Sets `active = false` AND `governance.paused = false`. Use when
the threat turns out non-existent.
4. `cleanup_expired_emergency` (permissionless) — after 24h, clears
`active = false` only (paused stays). Forces council to either
`governance_execute(UnpauseProtocol)` (resume normal ops) or
`governance_propose(PauseProtocol)` (sustain via canonical
timelock). The 24h auto-clear prevents an emergency_pause from
permanently halting the protocol if the council fails to act.
**Invariants:**
- `active = true` ⇒ `started_at_slot != 0`
- `started_by != Pubkey::default()` whenever `active = true`
- `active = false` after `emergency_resume` or `cleanup_expired_emergency`

4+4   bid_ask_spread_bps + pad    =     8 B
8     depth_100k_usd_micro        =     8 B
8     volume_24h_usd_micro        =     8 B
8     iv_bid_28d_micro            =     8 B

route matches the current SPL-token owner.

types.name: OptionType
docs: Option payoff types. Direction (Call/Put) is carried in
`OptionAccount.direction`. Digital / CappedVanilla / RangeAccrual satisfy
Boundary-Aware Theorem 1 (`sup{payoff} < ∞`). Vanilla is unbounded for
short Call; `compute_im` uses ScanRisk-only path for Vanilla shorts
(see `state::asset::OptionType::is_bounded_payoff`).
OneTouch was removed in the V3 amendment (2026-04-24 23:00 KST, the maintainer signed).
`#[repr(u8)]` (PR #6-prep, 2026-05-02) makes the in-memory layout
deterministically 1 byte — matches Borsh discriminant encoding so
`OptionAccount` (zero-copy `#[repr(C)]` per PR #6) can be safely
transmuted from raw account bytes.
W4.13 (2026-05-05) — option type 표현 일관화.
**on-chain enum = 6 variants**:
Vanilla / Digital / CappedVanilla / RangeAccrual / VanillaInverse /
DigitalInverse.
**(option_type, direction) valid product config = 11 combinations**:
- Vanilla        × {Call=+1, Put=-1}        = 2
- Digital        × {Call=+1, Put=-1}        = 2
- CappedVanilla  × {Call=+1, Put=-1}        = 2
- RangeAccrual   × {symmetric=0}            = 1
- VanillaInverse × {Call=+1, Put=-1}        = 2
- DigitalInverse × {Call=+1, Put=-1}        = 2
Total = **11 product configs** (validate_direction 가 enforce).
**Settlement mint axis** (orthogonal to enum × direction):
- USDC: linear payout, all 6 enum variants 적용
- SOL / wSOL: native (Linear) family + Inverse family — 6 × {USDC,
SOL} 의 부분집합 (UI / docs 에서 "SOL-quoted" 표기, 코드는 settlement_mint
pubkey 로 구별)
**마케팅 vs 코드 차이**:
- "11 옵션 타입" — accurate ↔ valid (enum, direction) configs 수
- "6 옵션 타입" — accurate ↔ enum variants 수 (방향/settlement 무시)
- "10 옵션 타입" — partial (RangeAccrual 의 symmetric direction 미포함)
외부 docs (README, landing, SDK) 가 어떤 차원 기준 인지 명시 필요.

types.name: ParamName
docs: Parameter handle for admin parameter updates.  The value range / type for
each variant is documented in `constants/mod.rs` next to the canonical
constant. `governance_execute` (I09) decodes the variant + writes the
matching slot. Adding a new parameter REQUIRES amendment + Day 14+ IDL
redeploy (this is a closed enum — closed-set discipline matches §15.7).

types.name: PoVSState
docs: Per-asset PoVS state vector. Layout matches spec §33.3 byte-for-byte.
Field order is **load-bearing**: changing it breaks all open accounts on
devnet. Padding bytes are explicit so the layout is portable across
Rust compiler revisions and bytemuck-safe.
Total `repr(C)` size:
1+7  asset+padding_0           =     8
8    last_update_slot          =     8
8    sigma_t_micro             =     8
8    sigma_inf_micro           =     8
8    theta_d_micro             =     8
8    vrp_rel_micro (i64)       =     8
8    iv_micro                  =     8
8    p_max_micro               =     8
8    xi_micro (i64)            =     8
8    beta_micro                =     8
8    var_99_micro              =     8
8    es_999_micro              =     8
8    regime_indicator_micro    =     8
2+2+4  returns_{idx,count}+padding_1 =     8
2160 iv_history [IvHistoryEntry; 90] (24×90) = 2160
1+1+6  iv_idx + bump + padding_2     =     8
4+2+2  sigma_inf_window + confidence_bps + padding_3 = 8 (Phase 1505.A.B
spec §3.1 append — adaptive YZ window §4.5 + cold-start flag §6.9)
total                                =  5168 bytes  (+ 8 Anchor discriminator
via `#[account]` = 5176
on-chain rent target)
CU budget: zero_copy load + 9-step `update_state` writes ≈ 6.4 kCU per slot
(spec §3.3, ~3.2% of the 200 kCU per-instruction envelope).

fields.name: sigma_t_micro
docs: EWMA σ_t, annualised, scaled by 1e6 (spec §4.1, RiskMetrics λ=0.94).

fields.name: sigma_inf_micro

fields.name: theta_d_micro
docs: Heston closed-form θ_d for T = 28d (spec §5.1), scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: vrp_rel_micro
docs: AR(1) 1-step VRP forecast, signed, scaled by 1e6 (spec §6.3).

fields.name: iv_micro
docs: PoVS forecast IV @ ATM 28d (spec §7.1), scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: p_max_micro
docs: Current `p_max` shock floor, scaled by 1e6
(spec §11.3 `p_max_floor` × adjustment).

fields.name: xi_micro
docs: POT-GPD ξ tail index (spec §26.2), signed, scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: beta_micro
docs: POT-GPD β scale parameter, scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: var_99_micro
docs: VaR_99 from POT-GPD fit, scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: es_999_micro
docs: ES_99.9% from POT-GPD fit, scaled by 1e6.

fields.name: regime_indicator_micro
docs: Hamilton 2-state filter posterior `r_t ∈ [0, 1]`, scaled by 1e6
(spec §25.2 / §3.2 Step 5). Source-of-truth for the
`regime_indicator` field per amendment §1.8 — `TwivPda` does NOT
store this; anchor-plus's `oracle.rs::update_twiv` reads it from here.

fields.name: returns_buf
docs: 720-day ring buffer of log returns × 1e6.

fields.name: returns_idx
docs: Next-write index into [`Self::returns_buf`].

fields.name: returns_count
docs: Number of entries currently populated (saturates at [`RETURNS_BUF_LEN`]).

fields.name: iv_history

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump seed.

fields.name: sigma_inf_window
docs: Adaptive Yang-Zhang σ_∞ window length in days (spec §4.5).
Discrete domain `{180, 365, 720}` — `update_state` re-evaluates every
180 slots and writes the chosen window here. Default at init = 180
(most-recent regime; slow-roll out to 365/720 as `returns_count`
grows past the corresponding thresholds).

fields.name: confidence_bps
docs: Cold-start flag in bps (0 = cold, 10000 = full). Spec §6.9 / §32.6
Theorem 6 — synthetic IV cold-start ramp. Promoted to `10_000` once
`iv_history.len() == 90` (≥ 90-day high-confidence window). New 5th
asset HYPE (post-launch enrolment) starts at `0` and ramps via
`synth_iv_calibrate` (Phase 1535-Instr10p wrapper, blocked on
skew-pricing workspace decision).

docs: Emitted when SKEW_AUTHORITY mutates a series-level `max_oi_count` cap.
`prev_max_oi == 0` means "no cap → cap set"; `new_max_oi == 0` means

headroom-at-update without a separate read. Per-strike OI ceiling is
Skew's first-mover defense against the 16.5 bp / $9 B option-expiration
pinning effect (Ni-Pearson-Poteshman 2005, JFE 78); CME / Deribit /
Derive enforce no equivalent strike-level cap.

types.name: SkewMetricsPda
docs: Per-asset SSVI advisor metrics (PoVS spec §31.5 P07 + §31.6 P08).
Layout (after Anchor 8-byte discriminator):
1+1+6  asset + bump + padding_0     =   8
8      last_update_slot             =   8
8      atm_iv_28d_micro             =   8
8      rr25_micro (i64)             =   8
8      bf25_micro (i64)             =   8
8      rr10_micro (i64)             =   8
8      atm_slope_micro (i64)        =   8
8 × 8  iv_per_tenor_micro [8]       =  64
Total body                          = 120 B
With 8 B Anchor discriminator       = 128 B

fields.name: atm_iv_28d_micro
docs: ATM 28d IV (spec §31.6 anchor tenor) × 1e6.

fields.name: rr25_micro
docs: 25Δ Risk Reversal = σ(25ΔC) − σ(25ΔP) × 1e6 (spec §31.5).
Negative under put-skew premium (R8 — universally crypto).

fields.name: bf25_micro
docs: 25Δ Butterfly = (σ(25ΔC) + σ(25ΔP))/2 − σ(ATM) × 1e6 (spec §31.5).

fields.name: rr10_micro
docs: 10Δ Risk Reversal × 1e6 (tail skew, spec §31.5).

fields.name: atm_slope_micro
docs: ATM slope ∂σ/∂k|_{k=0} × 1e6 (spec §31.5).

fields.name: iv_per_tenor_micro

Literal `8` (not `SKEW_METRICS_TENOR_COUNT`) because Anchor's

types.name: TierDowngraded
docs: Emitted by `downgrade_tier` when a CM steps down a rung after the
30-day lockup. `released_collateral` is the USDC freed back into the
`free_collateral()` pool by the rung change.

types.name: TierUpgraded
docs: Emitted by `upgrade_tier` when a CM advances to a higher capital rung.
`new_lockup_collateral` is the absolute USDC micro-units locked under
the new tier; `tier_locked_until` is the unix ts at which a downgrade
becomes permissible (now + `TIER_LOCKUP_MIN_SECONDS`, 30 d).

fields.name: from_tier
docs: Tier discriminant before the upgrade (`u8` for IDL stability —
matches `VerifiedTier::rank()`).

types.name: VerifiedTier
docs: Four-rung clearing-member capital ladder. The discriminants are stable
(numeric ordering matches capability ordering — strictly increasing IM
efficiency / wider concentration cap / heavier compute path) and must
never be reassigned. Default for every newly-registered CM is
`Standard`.
Each tier unlocks a different margin algorithm in `calculate_margin`:
| Tier | Lockup | Algorithm |
| Standard | 0 | ScanRisk 60-scenario (current path) |
| Silver | $500K | ConvexHullIM 2-dim + same-asset calendar netting (50%) |
| Gold | $2M | ConvexHullIM 5-dim SSVI + full calendar netting (85%) |
| Platinum | $10M | ConvexHullIM 25-dim ICC cross-asset + Hamilton 2-state |
**Tier monotonicity invariant** — strictly enforced by
`calculate_margin::handler` and unit-tested across 5 fixture portfolios:
`IM_Standard ≥ IM_Silver ≥ IM_Gold ≥ IM_Platinum`. A higher-tier path
can never produce a higher IM than the conservative Standard floor; if
the ConvexHullIM closed-form returns a higher value (numerical edge
case), the dispatch reverts to the Standard fallback so the worst-case
IM is always the published Standard value.
Source of truth for thresholds + activation criteria:
`docs/verified-tier-thresholds.md`.
